name: Camp Jabberwocky Summer Camp
description_short: A free overnight camp on Martha's Vineyard for children and adults with a wide range of disabilities. Campers live in accessible cabins and have about one counselor each. Days include classes, beach trips and outings around the island.
special_needs_notes: Serves children and adults with a wide range of disabilities. No age limits. Campers must be able to sleep through the night without waking others and be comfortable sleeping away from home. Usually one counselor per camper. All cabins have ramps, and each has a large accessible outdoor shower. Anyone bringing a power wheelchair must also bring a manual chair for off-campus activities. The camp says it cannot promise accommodations that come at the expense of the community as a whole.
swim_waterfront_notes: Afternoon beach trips most days. Boating includes kayaks and paddle boarding. The page gives no details on swimming supervision.
